note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Anthropic opens Australian retail IPO offering as AI scrutiny intensifies
items.blurb: Anthropic opened retail share sales in Australia as the government plans an AI safety regulator with mandatory incident reporting.

items.title: CoreWeave stock pops 11% after outlook raise eases AI slowdown concerns
items.blurb: Third-quarter sales rose 168% to $3.7 billion, and CoreWeave lifted its 2026 revenue forecast to at least $13 billion.

items.title: Nvidia shares rebound 5% as Huang faces scrutiny ahead of earnings
items.blurb: Nvidia recovered after two days of losses tied to its CEO's affair probe; quarterly earnings arrive Nov 17.

items.title: U.S., China should 'harbor no illusions' as they cooperate, compete on AI, Bessent says
items.blurb: Bessent says Washington and Beijing set up a dialogue on superintelligence risks but made no commitment to limit AI development.

items.title: Baird downgrades Nvidia on CEO Huang worries, AI uncertainty
items.blurb: Baird cut Nvidia to neutral and its price target to $200 from $500, citing AI spending doubts and leadership risk.

items.title: The Download: preserving minds and weighing open AI risks
items.blurb: Weighs whether freely downloadable frontier models are worth their misuse risk, after Anthropic flagged a Chinese open model's hacking skill.

items.title: The AI industry's week from hell
items.blurb: Anthropic's IPO, Nvidia's CEO scandal and midterm voter backlash against data centers hit the AI industry in the same week.

items.title: Anthropic sets price range of $70 to $78 in upcoming IPO as AI lab marches towards Nasdaq
items.blurb: The top of the range values Anthropic near $1.4 trillion; filings show $33 billion in nine-month revenue.

items.title: SoftBank swings to $7 billion loss after U.S. data center hit and Intel share decline
items.blurb: OpenAI's biggest outside backer lost money on data-center power equipment; its OpenAI stake is valued at $99.6 billion.

items.title: Nvidia scandal fails to bring down the tech bulls as spy investigation widens
items.blurb: Investors kept buying chip stocks as the FBI probe into Jensen Huang's ties to an alleged Chinese spy widened.

items.title: AI stocks bounce back — with one notable exception
items.blurb: AI shares recovered after last week's post-midterm sell-off, while Nvidia lagged amid scrutiny of its chief executive.

items.title: The Download: Pelosi's successor targets AI and data centers face power woes
items.blurb: Incoming congressman Scott Wiener plans federal AI rules as local opposition to data centers grows over power demand.

items.title: Anthropic seeks to be valued at more than $1 trillion
items.blurb: The offering could raise up to $62.5 billion, a test of investor appetite for AI amid a shaky market.

items.title: Google's AI takes a big step toward hacker-proof, "unhackable" software
items.blurb: Google DeepMind says Gemini 4 Carbon agents mathematically verified that code behind Signal's encryption is secure.

items.title: Anthropic wants Claude to join your meetings
items.blurb: Anthropic pushes Claude deeper into office work with new team tools, a direct challenge to Microsoft and Google productivity suites.

items.title: Stocks moving the most midday: Microsoft drops suddenly on Anthropic threat to Office
items.blurb: Microsoft fell about 3% after Anthropic launched Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Data, tools that overlap with Office.

items.title: How Nvidia's crisis and politics could deliver the pause AI leaders want
items.blurb: Midterm backlash against data centers and Nvidia's leadership crisis could slow the AI buildout, Axios reports.

items.title: CoreWeave earnings put debt-fueled AI build-out under scrutiny
items.blurb: CoreWeave reports third-quarter results as investors question how much debt is funding AI data-center expansion.

items.title: Nvidia hires law firm Wachtell Lipton to lead Jensen Huang affair probe
items.blurb: Nvidia's board brought in outside lawyers to investigate its CEO, as the stock extended its slide.

items.title: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy further complicates Nvidia's China problem
items.blurb: The scandal adds pressure on Nvidia's China business as Congress prepares to scrutinize the chipmaker's ties there.

items.title: 'Markets bottom on bad news' maxim rings true as chip stocks rally amid Nvidia scandal
items.blurb: Chip stocks broadly rallied even as Nvidia fell, suggesting investors are separating the company from the wider AI trade.

items.title: CoreWeave beats on revenue and lifts guidance, easing AI slowdown concerns
items.blurb: Third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion and the backlog hit $132.5 billion, a read on AI cloud demand.

items.title: Schumer accuses Trump of defending Nvidia CEO Huang at cost of national security
items.blurb: The Huang affair probe is becoming a partisan fight over chip-export policy toward China.

items.title: The stock market 'dodged a real bullet' — Cramer on Anthropic's new IPO valuation
items.blurb: Anthropic's $70 to $78 price range is being read as a test of investor appetite for AI labs.
